geometry.phase_definition: 0 matrix, 1 homogenized yarn; no fibre-scale strands or void phase
geometry.orientation_definition: columns: reference centreline tangent, in-plane transverse, their right-handed cross product
geometry.topology: cyclic pairwise over/under with staggered crossings
geometry.projection_scope: normal-plane Newton solve; sampled overlap check is not a proof of continuous surface clearance

definition.resolution_scope: three grid cells across yarn height at grid96; an initial resolved discretization, not a convergence result; extra particles do not replace grid refinement
definition.material_scope: generic illustrative engineering constants; no calibrated fibre/resin grade
definition.constitutive_scope: fully bonded single-grid matrix and continuous interlaced yarns; neo-Hookean matrix and orthotropic Saint Venant-Kirchhoff yarns; no debonding, damage, fracture or Z binders
definition.comparison_scope: same outer dimensions and engineering constants; architectures have different yarn volume fractions, so differences are not attributed to topology alone
definition.loading_regime: dynamic displacement control; not a quasi-static material test
definition.weft_loading_definition: global z loading; triaxial families are 0,+60,-60 degrees and have no 90-degree yarn family

loading_definition.constraints: left support fixes x/y, right support fixes y, small left mid-width patch fixes z; central upper patch prescribes y only

definition.reaction_sampling: force on each grid fixture in a replay of the next step; sample time=t+dt, includes inertia and earlier constraints
definition.section_force_measure: reference central slab quadrature of P=tau*F^-T; sum(P_iA*V0/slab_width), two reference layers on an even lattice
definition.section_moment_measure: central x-plane reference moment about z: -sum((Y0-Ycenter)*P_xx*V0/slab_width)
definition.boundary_tracking_scope: moving-box samples remain at least 1.5dx from all reference faces, covering every grid phase under exact prescribed translation; static boxes use initial discrete support; current complete support is counted separately; no interior samples means no direct tracking claim
